title: RAG-as-a-Service
oneLiner: Multi-user document Q&A platform with background ingestion and switchable embedding providers.
objective: Rebuild an earlier single-script RAG tool with the architecture the pattern actually needs: a vector store, authentication, versioned schema and ingestion that never blocks a request.
achievements: Built a FastAPI backend on four backing services, each with one job: PostgreSQL for users and metadata, Milvus for vector search, Redis as the queue and Celery workers for ingestion.
Moved document ingestion off the request path — uploads return immediately while a worker parses, chunks, embeds and indexes.
Put embeddings behind one interface: Ollama locally, OpenAI hosted, swappable without touching call sites.
Added JWT logins with role-ready structure, Alembic schema migrations and ingestion for PDF, TXT, DOCX and CSV.
